outlet: Journal of the San Juan Islands, 'Auditor's Office presents 2027 preliminary budget to Council', Sept. 3, 2026
notes: On Aug. 25, 2026 the Council received the 2027 preliminary budget prepared by the Auditor's Office; about $3.7 million in staffing and service modifications incorporated; balanced as required, with further reductions or new revenue expected for 2028.
